featured_reviews.name: Rupali Bhonsle
featured_reviews.review_text:
Lost trust in Tata Products and Croma…

After the passing of Sir Ratan Tata, I truly feel there is no one left who follows his values and customer-first approach.

I purchased all the white goods for my house from the Croma Mahavir Nagar branch purely because I trusted the Tata name. Unfortunately, that trust turned out to be my biggest mistake.

Along with the products, I was sold their “Zip Care Service” with a 4-year extended warranty, in which the cost for AC product was nearly ₹10,000. However, within just one year, my OGeneral AC stopped working. What followed was an exhausting struggle to even connect with the service team.

The technician sent by Croma was poorly trained and unable to diagnose the issue. Instead, he casually blamed it on a rat-bitten wire and refused to help further. After repeated follow-ups and complaints, Croma finally arranged for an official OGeneral technician visit, and surprisingly, the issue turned out to be very minor — the AC started functioning immediately.

Following this experience, I requested a refund for the Zip Care amount and even escalated the matter to the CEO’s office. Though I did receive a response assuring a refund, till date I have neither received the payment nor a permanent solution to the recurring AC problem.

The AC continues to malfunction repeatedly, and every time it does, the power supply of my entire house trips off. Today again, the AC has stopped working.

When I contacted Croma customer care today and spoke with Ms. Bharati, I was shocked by the response. I was asked whether I wanted a refund or a technician visit — as if both cannot happen together. I was indirectly told that if I proceed with a service complaint, my refund request may not be considered.

I am completely frustrated and mentally exhausted dealing with this ongoing issue. I no longer have the patience to repeatedly chase customer service for basic support.

At this stage, I demand an immediate replacement of this faulty product and a proper resolution without any further delays.

I sincerely hope the higher authorities at Croma understand the seriousness of this matter and take immediate action.

#Croma #TataGroup
